unit_attributes.statement: The Community Services Block Grant Act, comprising chapter 106, was originally enacted by subtitle B of Pub. L. 97–35 (Aug. 13, 1981, 95 Stat. 511) and amended by several intervening public laws (Pub. L. 97–115, Pub. L. 98–288, Pub. L. 98–558, Pub. L. 99–425, Pub. L. 101–501, Pub. L. 101–624, Pub. L. 103–94, Pub. L. 103–171, and Pub. L. 103–252), but is shown herein as having been added by Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201 (Oct. 27, 1998, 112 Stat. 2728), without reference to those intervening amendments due to the extensive revision of that Act by Pub. L. 105–285.
